title.narrative: Stöd till Mekanism för konfliktrelaterat sexuellt våld i Sudan 2025-26
Support to Mechanism on conflict related sexual violence in Sudan 2025-26 - Support to Mechanism on conflict related sexual violence in Sudan

description.narrative: Stöd till Mekanism för konfliktrelaterat sexuellt våld i Sudan 2025-26 för att kunna dokumentera och verifiera fall. Detta inkluderar finansiering av en function (Women Protection Advisor) för koordinering av arbetet.

Support to Mechanism on conflict related sexual violence in Sudan 2025-26 to document and verify cases. This includes supporting the Women Protection Advisor for coordination.
The goal of the project is to mitigate CRSV risks and enhance the response in Sudan through establishment of a Senior Women Protection Adviser (SWPA) position that will support the United Nations political engagement, as well as the re-establishment of the MARA infrastructure at country-level. The SWPA position will receive technical support, guidance, and backstopping from SVC-mandated staff at the global level, including knowledge products, resources and tools drawing upon best practices and lessons learnt, as well as fostering connections and partnerships with relevant UN system actors from among the 26-member entities of the UN Action Network.
Outcome 1: Strengthened system-wide coordination, enhanced data analysis and reporting and increased political engagement on CRSV Output 1.1: The UN Working Group on CRSV is established, convened, and coordinated and the MARA is revitalized and functional. Output 1.2: Enhanced political engagement and advocacy by the UN and CSO stakeholders leading to increased efforts by the government/duty-bearer to prevent and respond to CRSV. Outcome 2: Enhanced uptake and use of global knowledge products, guidance and tools on CRSV amongst UN, government stakeholders, and CSO partners Output 2.1: Global knowledge, guidance, and tools on CRSV among stakeholders is contextualized and disseminated with relevant stakeholders, including women-led organizations and survivors.

The proposed project will support the achievement of three Outcome areas of UN Actions Strategic Framework including:
Outcome 1: Survivors and at-risk groups are supported and protected and CRSV risks are prevented and mitigated (Res 1820).
Outcome 2: Duty bearers and decision-makers take action to address both the immediate risks as well as the root causes of CRSV at the global and national level and promote compliance and accountability.
Outcome 3: Reliable, timely and objective information on CRSV trends, risks and patterns supports evidence-based high-level advocacy, enhances engagement with and pressure on the parties to conflict and informs impactful, survivor-centered solutions.
